# Disk 5 of 5 — Frontend Mailers & Extras

Per the original FILE_ID.DIZ, this disk held:
- BinkleyTerm XE — FidoNet mailer (EMSI/Hydra/Janus/ZModem)

## Reconstruction source (present in this tree)

BinkleyTerm XE source is in `reference/btxe-source.zip` (btxe/src/).
Per project notes, 99/99 DOS files compile.

## Rebuild target

Build BinkleyTerm XE (the crew's build reaches full DOS compile), then
package into the disk image. The mailer binary is the byte-exact target.
